title: ClearPath Continuity Scaling of Professional Services Projects Remobilization Fees
content:
For ClearPath Managed IT Services clients on the upper tiers, the remobilization fee of a Professional Services Projects engagement resumed after a long client-caused hold is scaled down.

The remobilization fee is scaled by 0.6 for a client whose ClearPath agreement in active status is on the ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise tier and covers 100 or more seats, by 0.8 for a client on one of those tiers covering fewer than 100 seats, and not at all for any other client.

| Active ClearPath agreement on Professional, Premier or Enterprise? | Seats covered | Scaling |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 100 or more | 0.6 |
| Yes | fewer than 100 | 0.8 |
| No | any | none |

Hypothetical illustration: a ClearPath Enterprise client in active status covering 40 seats has the fee scaled by 0.8; a ClearPath Essentials client covering 400 seats is not scaled.
